subject: Social Media
title: State Troll Farms
description: A micro-lesson that makes State Troll Farms usable.

hook.text: In St. Petersburg, Russia, hundreds of workers sit in cubicles posting on American social media all day.

buildup.text: The Internet Research Agency created fake American personas. They ran BLM pages and pro-gun groups simultaneously.

discovery.text: The goal wasn't to support any side. It was to inflame both sides. Division itself was the product.

twist.text: Russian trolls organized real protests in Texas—on opposing sides of the same issue, at the same location.

climax.text: Americans showed up to protest each other, not knowing the same foreign office had invited them both.

punchline.text: The best propaganda makes enemies of neighbors.

quiz.question: What was the main goal of Russian troll farms on American social media?
